figures.finding: As item 1. The public broadcaster lists 'original works' (الأعمال الأصلية), Iraqi drama series among them, on its own site; its site is a script-rendered application and no commissioning terms, tariff or count of independent series taken up was reached. The Communications and Media Commission (cmc.iq, the regulator) was reached; its listed documents are on consumer protection, performance indicators, frequencies and training, none on content quotas.
